svg.title: Language Composition
svg.desc: Language usage across 24 included public repositories. TypeScript: 42.0%; Python: 25.0%; C#: 14.0%; ShaderLab: 8.0%; Shell: 6.0%; HTML: 5.0%. This is a quantized 200-unit chart: 1 bead = 0.5%; unit counts are quantized, while the legend shows exact percentages.
